definitions.explanation: A device for controlling the flow of water from a pipe, typically with a handle that can be turned.

examples.japanese: {蛇口|じゃぐち}をひねって{水|みず}を{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I turn the faucet to run the water.
examples.notes: 蛇口をひねる = to turn the faucet

examples.japanese: {蛇口|じゃぐち}から{水|みず}が{漏|も}れている。
examples.english: Water is leaking from the faucet.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{終|お}わったら{蛇口|じゃぐち}を{閉|し}めてください。
examples.english: Please close the faucet when you're done.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The name literally means "snake mouth" ({蛇|へび}+{口|ぐち}), referring to the shape of traditional faucet spouts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{蛇口|じゃぐち}をひねる (to turn the faucet)
・{蛇口|じゃぐち}を{開|あ}ける/{閉|し}める (to open/close the faucet)
・{蛇口|じゃぐち}から{水|みず}が{出|で}る (water comes from the faucet)
・{水道|すいどう}の{蛇口|じゃぐち} (water tap)

ALTERNATIVE TERM:
・{水栓|すいせん} (more technical term for tap/valve)

[Register: Neutral]
